user_intent: 如果 人在家 那么 增加 亮度
期望 温度 处于 20 ℃ 到 28 ℃
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_temperature() > 28 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN turn_on_natural_fan() mijia_natural_fan
IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_temperature() < 20 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN turn_on_high_mode() yunmi_AI_heater
IF mijia_air_purifier_MAX.get_PM2_5() > 18 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN turn_on() mijia_air_purifier_MAX
IF mijia_air_purifier_MAX.get_PM2_5() > 18 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN turn_on() mijia_air_purifier
IF generic_hood_version_1.reading() > 0.22 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN power_on() generic_hood_version_1
